ceiling_clamp.evidence: OssSyncService.js line 34 const CADENCE_CEILING_MS=60_000. _clampCadence (line 430) returns floored <= ceiling. Sentinel posOssCadenceCap.spec.js#L106-L114 verifies 999999999ms→60000ms. Sister symmetry with PosSyncService + KDS (Wave 3c KDS-ADV3C-07/08 P1 healed via 9ff26e12b family).
ceiling_clamp.blast_radius_if_removed: Owner misconfig FK_CATALOG_OSS_FALLBACK_CONNECTED_INTERVAL_MS=999999999 would freeze customer wall for 11.5 days during Pusher outage, blowing SYNC-2 budget (POS pay → OSS visible ≤8s).

floor_clamp.evidence: OssSyncService.js line 35 const CADENCE_FLOOR_MS=250. _clampCadence returns candidate >= 250. Sentinel posOssCadenceCap.spec.js#L126-L135 verifies 1ms→250ms.
floor_clamp.blast_radius_if_removed: Misconfig to 1ms would DDoS the public OSS endpoint (GET /oss-order). 4 polls/s × 10 TV walls = 40 req/s sustained, breaching the rate-limiter.

default_disconnected_2s.evidence: DEFAULTS.intervalMsWhenDisconnected=2_000 (line 16). Comment on lines 10-15 explains: SYNC-2 8s budget must be met by polling alone when broadcast queue is idle in dev. Prod uses Echo live so this fallback is essentially unused there.
default_disconnected_2s.concern: 10 TV walls × 1 poll/2s = 5 req/s sustained per branch when WS is down. Throttle bucket should handle this — confirm rate-limiter on /oss-order endpoint.

default_connected_60s.evidence: DEFAULTS.intervalMsWhenConnected=60_000 (line 9). With WS healthy, Echo is the primary push channel; 60s sweep catches missed broadcasts (network jitter, transient Pusher drops not surfacing as disconnected event).

exponential_backoff_5xx.evidence: DEFAULTS.backoffStartMs=5_000, backoffCapMs=30_000 (lines 17-18). _handle5xx (line 323-332) doubles _currentBackoffMs each fail, caps at backoffCapMs. ossSyncFallback.spec.js#L98-L124 asserts curve 5→10→20→30s.

visibility_burst_throttle_1s.evidence: DEFAULTS.visibilityBurstMinIntervalMs=1_000 (line 24). _burstPoll (line 237-252) rejects if now-lastBurstPollAt < minGap. Protects against focus/blur storm (e.g. user repeatedly Cmd+Tab).

dev_warn_disconnect_threshold.evidence: DEFAULTS.devWarnAfterDisconnectMs=10_000 (line 26). _maybeWarnDisconnect (line 254-274) fires single console.warn when (a) disconnected ≥10s AND (b) appEnv !== 'production' AND (c) not already warned this disconnect window. _devWarnedDisconnected reset on connect (line 173).

tz_correctness.verdict: CORRECT after Wave 3c KDS-ADV3C-04 P0 heal
tz_correctness.evidence: now('UTC')->subHours() ensures the bound literal matches order_datetime column's UTC storage (line 108 comment block). Pre-heal: Paris-local bind would slip prune window by 1-2h. Sentinel SisterServicesTzAwareV2Test.

stale_prune.concern: 8h window matches typical single-shift fast-food. SaaS branches with longer hours override via env. Documentation in config/oss.php line 25 explicit.

tz_correctness_today_window.verdict: CORRECT after Wave 3b KDS-ADV3B-01 P0 heal
tz_correctness_today_window.evidence: Carbon::today($appTz)->setTimezone('UTC') / Carbon::today($appTz)->endOfDay()->setTimezone('UTC') correctly converts midnight-Paris to the UTC instant before binding against TIMESTAMP column. Sentinel SisterServicesTzAwareTest.
tz_correctness_today_window.regression_class: Pre-heal: Carbon::today() in Paris bound as Paris-local 'Y-m-d H:i:s' against UTC-stored column dropped 00:00-02:00 Paris orders (winter) / 00:00-01:00 (summer) from the wall.

deterministic_ordering.evidence: Without explicit ordering, MySQL returns unordered set; polls re-shuffled customer wall between fetches; customers saw queue position jump. Heal forces FIFO by queue_number + id tiebreaker.

concerns_for_red.title: Disconnected cadence 2s × N TV walls per branch
concerns_for_red.detail: 10 TV walls × 1 poll/2s = 5 req/s/branch during sustained Pusher outage. Confirm /api/frontend/oss-order has rate-limiter middleware (config/throttle/api defaults to 60/min). At 5 req/s a single TV wall fits, but worst-case 10 walls would hit 300 req/min/branch.

concerns_for_red.title: Burst-poll on visibility while WS is connected wastes one request
concerns_for_red.detail: Tab regains visibility → _burstPoll fires regardless of WS state. If WS is connected and just delivered the update, burst-poll re-fetches the same data. Trivial cost (one HTTP round-trip). Not a defect — just a minor over-fetch.

concerns_for_red.title: ws_state listener race on _wsService swap
concerns_for_red.detail: If window._wsService is replaced mid-lifecycle (e.g. Echo reconnect with new instance), the cached this._webSocketService in OssSyncService still points to the old service. stop()/start() cycle would resolve. Confirm Echo replace pattern in admin shell.

verdict: Sync hygiene is PRODUCTION-GRADE. Cadence clamps prevent silent-blind misconfig (DDoS floor + freeze ceiling). Fail-closed allowlist enforces public TV wall data minimization at the database layer (not just the resource serializer — defense in depth). TZ-aware boundaries are correct UTC. Deterministic FIFO ordering. Sentinel coverage: posOssCadenceCap + ossSyncFallback + OssCustomerScreenFilterTest + SisterServicesTzAwareTest + ossWakeLockOnMount + ossChimePublicWall + orderStatusScreenOssSync.
